one_month_reasoning: ALAB's Q3 2026 report is expected ~Nov 3-5, just after the Oct 29 window, so the main company catalyst falls outside it. Inside the window: hyperscaler Q3 prints and 2027 capex commentary (Alphabet/Microsoft/Meta ~Oct 27-29, Amazon on the edge), which I read as mildly positive since no hyperscaler has cut capex and Goldman/BofA see ~$1.1-1.2T in 2027; against that, the Oct 28 FOMC with ~70% priced odds of a 25bp hike (CNBC Sep 23) is a headwind for a ~56x P/E name, and OpenAI's training pause widened on Sep 28 with no restart date (sentiment risk). Net: roughly symmetric lognormal at annual vol/3.5 (~0.27-0.28) with the median nudged just below spot (~$356).

fair_value.method: Blend of forward P/E (CY2028E EPS ~$8.6 x 40x = $345, weight 0.6) and forward EV/sales (CY2028E revenue ~$4.0B x 15x + ~$2.0B net cash over ~190M diluted shares = $327, weight 0.4), giving ~$338 fair value at Sept 2027.

methods.name: P/E
methods.inputs: CY2028E non-GAAP EPS $8.63 (2027 consensus $6.39 x 1.35) x 40x forward multiple, applied at Sept 2027 when the market prices 2028

inputs_detail.derivation: Consensus 2027 growth ~56-59%; decelerate to ~35% for 2028, consistent with Marvell (data center >60% FY28), Broadcom (AI revenue doubling FY28) and Goldman/BofA 2027 capex +35-50%. Round-1 extra haircut for Trainium4/NVLink Fusion removed: that was Dec 2025 news, and native Trainium4 racks use UALink where ALAB keeps switch opportunities (Investing.com, The Register, Jefferies). A smaller residual haircut stays for Broadcom scale-up Ethernet and Marvell-XConn competition for the same sockets.

Stock currently trades ~56x 2027 consensus EPS ($357.84/$6.39); high-growth AI connectivity peers (Credo, Broadcom) trade at lower multiples as growth normalizes; 40x on a year-forward EPS at a point when growth decelerates toward ~30% is a de-rating from today's multiple.

methods.name: EV/sales
methods.inputs: CY2028E revenue $4.01B (2027 consensus $2.97B x 1.35) x 15x EV/sales + ~$2.0B net cash, / ~190M diluted shares

inputs_detail.derivation: 2027 consensus x 1.35, same growth logic as P/E method

~72-74% gross margin and ~39% non-GAAP operating margin (Q2 2026) support a premium semis multiple; current EV/2027 sales is ~(66.2B-1.25B)/2.97B = ~22x; assume de-rating to 15x on 2028 as growth slows.

Cash + marketable securities $1.25B at June 30 2026, no debt; H1 2026 OCF only $162.3M during the receivables/inventory build, but Q3-Q4 guide (~$550M/qtr revenue at ~39%+ op margin) implies faster cash generation as working capital normalizes; ~$0.75B net add over 15 months -> ~$2.0B (raised from $1.5B, which assumed too much working-capital drag).
Q3 2026 guidance of ~185M weighted diluted shares plus ~2-3% annual dilution from SBC.

bear.story: AI capex digestion (Sept-2026 slowdown rhetoric and widening frontier-lab training pauses turn into actual 2027-28 budget cuts) or Scorpio X loses or double-sources the AWS socket after Trainium3; Broadcom Tomahawk Ultra/scale-up Ethernet and Marvell-XConn take share; a hiking Fed compresses multiples. 2028 EPS ~$6.7 at ~29x.

base.story: Q3 lands near the $540-560M guide, Scorpio becomes the largest line, 2027 revenue ~$3B with beats; UALink switches for native Trainium4 racks plus P-Series wins at additional hyperscalers extend scale-up revenue beyond Trainium3; multiple de-rates from ~56x to ~42-44x on 2028 EPS ~$8.6-8.8.

bull.story: Hyperscaler capex reaches Goldman's $1.2T+ in 2027; AWS purchases track toward the $6.5B warrant-vesting ceiling (a multi-year ceiling through 2033, not a committed order book) while UALink and optical engines win additional XPU programs; 2028 EPS >$11 and the market keeps ~55x.

thesis_break_reason: Below ~$205 (-43%, ~32x 2027 consensus EPS $6.39, ~24x my 2028E) the price would imply the market no longer believes in ~$3B 2027 revenue: most likely a lost or double-sourced AWS scale-up socket (Scorpio X / Trainium4 UALink), share loss to Broadcom scale-up Ethernet or Marvell-XConn, a Q4 guide at or below the Q3 level, or real hyperscaler capex cuts, rather than ordinary 99%-vol swings.

reasoning: Company facts: Q2 2026 revenue $392M (+104% y/y), non-GAAP EPS $0.80, Q3 guide $540-560M (+40% q/q), EPS $1.16-1.21, ~$1.25B cash, no debt. Industry chain remains strongly supportive: Broadcom AI revenue +221% with FY27/FY28 AI revenue guided to double; Marvell data center >60% FY28; Credo +115% y/y; Goldman/BofA 2027 hyperscaler capex ~$1.1-1.2T with no cuts after the Sept 14 slowdown selloff. Round-2 corrections from the supervisor, verified: the Trainium4 NVLink Fusion news dates from re:Invent Dec 2025 (ALAB -13% then, Jefferies called it an over-reaction) and native Trainium4 racks use UALink where ALAB keeps switch opportunities, so I removed the extra 2028 growth haircut (30% -> 35%); the Amazon $6.5B is a warrant-vesting ceiling through 2033, not a front-loaded order book; net cash raised to ~$2.0B. I keep my lane's competitive read (Broadcom Tomahawk Ultra scale-up Ethernet, Marvell-XConn) as the main residual reason 2028 growth is below the capex-implied rate. Valuation: 40x x $8.63 2028E = $345 and EV/sales 15x = $327, blended $338, ~6% below spot; base case $380 reflects the beat-and-raise pattern. Scenarios $195/$380/$630 at 25/50/25. Distribution: lognormal-like with median ~spot ($358) and sigma ~0.68 (below 99% realized, which includes the post-2025 re-rating), lower-middle slightly fattened for Fed-hike and AI-sentiment risk (OpenAI's widened training pause). Net ladder change vs round 1 is small and upward in the middle (+0.5-1 pt). Research: 2 additional searches in round 2.
